desc: Clean close three-quarter view of a white perforated soffit beneath a tiled Florida roof eave, showing the protected intake side of a continuous attic ventilation system.
reuse_notes: Use for soffit vents, attic intake-air context, roof-eave details, ventilation planning, and humidity-related exterior-envelope articles. It depicts a generic finished eave, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for determining net free vent area, baffle continuity, pest screening, or local code requirements.
